summary_1line: Rama effortlessly lifts and breaks Shiva’s bow before the assembly, proving his strength and winning King Janaka’s promise of Sita’s hand in marriage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama lifts the massive sacred bow from its iron chest before a vast crowd while King Janaka, Vishwamitra, and Lakshmana watch.
As Rama draws the bowstring, the bow snaps in two with a thunderous crack that shakes the earth and stuns the assembled crowd.
King Janaka, hands folded in reverence, declares that his daughter Sita will wed Rama after witnessing the broken bow.
